The '''Battle of Cattamscar''' was a skirmish which saw the conquest of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Cattamascar]] by a Ssi-ruuvi expeditionary fleet at some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Prelude==
When [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] made contact with the alien invaders called the [[Ssi-ruu]]k, he made a deal with them: In exchange for their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] technology, the invaders were allowed to attack smaller colonies at the edge of [[Wild Space/Legends|colonized space]].<ref name="TBSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> The Cattamascar colony in the [[Bakura sector/Legends|Bakura sector]] was one of these.<ref name="AOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==The battle==
Not much is known about this battle, except that the Ssi-ruuk were forced to perform an emergency jump, indicating that the resistance was heaver than expected from previous battles.<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

==Aftermath==
Despite the retreat, the Ssi-ruuk continued their invasion of the [[Shiritoku Spur]] until they were beaten at [[Bakura Incident|Bakura]].<ref name="TAB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle's only mention in canon so far was one line in ''The Truce at Bakura''. Neither the accompaning [[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook|sourcebook]] nor other works have mentioned the battle again.

The date of the battle is also unknown, but must be at some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], because [[Dev Sibwarra]] remembers the battle. He was captured during the [[Battle of G'rho]] in 1 BBY and remembers the incident during the Second Battle of Bakura, which is placed in 4 ABY.
